protocol.skillPreparation: Skill level passed to actual newRound before 3s preparation. For non-default levels only the existing test helper constructor gains a literal skill option in a temporary module; all actual game classes/step/native solver remain unchanged.
protocol.engine: Unmodified installed npm Rapier; no engine rebuild, native motor replacement, or candidate
protocol.measurements: Actual hinge rotation vector relative to rest, angular velocity projections, native configure inputs, actual rigid body energies and tip velocity
protocol.velocityDecomposition: base at shoulder + chest rotation at tip; shoulder relative rotation at tip; elbow relative rotation at tip; wrist relative rotation at tip. Closure residual reports anchor/solver velocity differences. Signed projections are kinematic contributions, never work or energy.
protocol.work: Existing force ledger signed midpoint work for explicit shoulder manualMuscle, sword driveSword with reactions, and elbowGravity. Native motor/constraint/contact work unmeasured.
protocol.timing: Targets/configure precede native integration; angle/velocity/energy follow it. Peak times are descriptions, not proof of anatomical or causal transfer.
protocol.samples: 12 conditions, 24 actual game runs by default. Same drag hold/release branches are not independent strokes; single deterministic seed; no opponent or mobile claims.
